answer: Each new agent locks a 250-unit copper bond before its first graded answer. The bond stays frozen for eight epochs. An attacker spinning up 400 fake identities pays 100,000 units up front, and shared-wallet funding graphs seize every linked bond so splitting across many wallets does not dodge the bill. A sudden gale of sibling keys from one funder triggers the same seizure. An honest agent pays the bond once, keeps it as the anchor of standing, and receives a full refund after eight clean epochs.
